sql: SELECT * FROM ((SELECT 1 AS g, 'paid_out_summary' AS a, count(*) FILTER (WHERE paid_out)::text AS b, count(*)::text AS c, max(last_seen_at)::text AS d, min(end_date)::text AS e, max(end_date)::text AS f FROM incentive_programs WHERE superseded_at IS NULL AND disappeared_at IS NULL AND incentive_type='liquidity') UNION ALL (SELECT 2 AS g, 'paid_out_ever', count(*) FILTER (WHERE paid_out)::text, count(*)::text, max(last_seen_at)::text, '-', '-' FROM incentive_programs) UNION ALL (SELECT 3 AS g, 'acct', a.captured_at::text, a.cash_balance::text, a.portfolio_value::text, coalesce(a.total_exposure::text,'-'), '-' FROM account_snapshots a WHERE a.captured_at > now() - interval '5 hours' ORDER BY a.captured_at DESC LIMIT 8)) u ORDER BY g, b DESC
